title: ParsedMessage.preview always None — documented as first ~256 chars
description: parse.rs line 46: 'preview: None' — ParsedMessage.preview is documented as 'Short preview of the message body (first ~256 chars of text content)' and the README lists it in the field table. The field is never populated. Callers relying on it will always get None. Either implement it or remove the field and its documentation.
